description: This Java class defines a Freemarker template transform for formatting numbers within the OFBiz framework. It processes input arguments to retrieve a number, locale, and format string, then outputs a formatted number string based on these parameters.

classes.name: OfbizNumberTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker template transform for formatting numbers according to specified locale and format parameters.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieve a string argument from the provided map, handling different potential object types.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Retrieve a numeric argument from the provided map, converting it to Double, with support for different model types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a Writer that processes the formatting of the number when the transform is invoked in a Freemarker template.
